title: Can you help me open this jar?
scene: 打不开某样东西，反复试。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can you help me open this jar?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Try twisting the lid the other way.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I can't do it, because it is too tight for me.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Push up with your thumb while you twist it.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Yeah, that's it — there it goes!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I did it all by myself! Well, sort of.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: That still counts as doing it yourself.

variations: "open this" 换 "tie this"；"too tight" 换 "too tricky"。
